analysis_summaries: The repository processes frames from a USB camera using a parallel YOLOv8 detection and YOLO11 pose-estimation pipeline. Each frame is resized and normalized by the model wrappers before inference. The detection decoder produces COCO class IDs, confidence scores, and boxes; the pose decoder produces person keypoints for skeleton rendering. Boxes and skeletons are drawn on the same frame and displayed.
